visual.description: Deep dark navy-purple used as the primary background throughout the entire page.
Slightly lighter dark surface used for cards, panels, and content areas.
Pure white used for primary headings and high-emphasis text.
Muted lavender-grey used for secondary body text, subdued labels, and footer links.
Light greyish-lavender used for paragraph text and medium-emphasis content.
Vivid orange-red used for the primary CTA button, logo accent, and key highlighted headline text.
Dark purple-tinted surface that appears as the nav background after scrolling.
White text used for navigation links in the top-of-page transparent state.
White text used for navigation links in the scrolled opaque nav state.
Bright blue used as an accent in feature card backgrounds and UI highlight areas.
Vibrant purple used as an accent in widget feature cards and scrolling feature backgrounds.
Lighter orange accent used in quick-add feature card backgrounds.
Yellow used as a small accent color in list icons and subtle UI elements.
Deep purple gradient overlay used in the hero and mid-page AI section backgrounds.
Purple used for footer category heading links like Company, App, Use Cases.
Amber-yellow used for the App footer column heading link.
Green used for the Updates footer column heading link.
Blue used for the Social footer column heading link.
